claims.quote: It was clear that Russia had no interest in peace, the leaders underlined.
claims.statement: Russia had no interest in peace.

claims.quote: Russia’s blatant indiscriminate attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure
claims.statement: Russia's attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure are blatant and indiscriminate.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister welcomed President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Ukraine to Downing Street this afternoon.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister welcomed President Volodymyr Zelenskyy of Ukraine to Downing Street.

facts.quote: The leaders began by reflecting on their call on Saturday
facts.statement: The leaders had a call on the Saturday before the meeting.

facts.quote: Russia’s blatant indiscriminate attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure since President Trump called for an energy ceasefire.
facts.statement: Russia has carried out attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure since President Trump called for an energy ceasefire.

facts.quote: particularly in response to Russia’s barrage of jet-powered drones
facts.statement: Russia has launched a barrage of jet-powered drones.

facts.quote: the Prime Minister set out the UK’s latest package of Lightweight Multirole Missiles.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister set out the UK's latest package of Lightweight Multirole Missiles.

facts.quote: The UK would continue to develop innovative military solutions for use on the battlefield in Ukraine
facts.statement: The UK intends to continue developing innovative military solutions for use on the battlefield in Ukraine, including retrofitting British capability onto equipment gifted from other partners.

facts.quote: the leaders discussed how the UK could accelerate defensive support to Ukraine ahead of the winter.

facts.quote: The UK would also continue its diplomatic efforts to support international supplies of defensive equipment too

facts.quote: Both looked forward to speaking again soon.
facts.statement: The two leaders look forward to speaking again soon.
